# @gnapex/sdk

> The official zero-config client SDK for GN-Apex-generated sites. Provides one TypeScript/JavaScript package covering content fetching (headless CMS client), automatic behavioral analytics, cookie-based authentication, local feature flags, realtime content sync over WebSocket, Web Push notifications, 16 atomic UI components, and diagnostics — for Next.js, React, and plain JavaScript/Node environments. Package name on npm: `@gnapex/sdk`. CLI binaries: `apex`, `nexus`.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) to help AI assistants and LLM-based tools accurately answer questions about this SDK, generate correct code samples, and avoid inventing APIs that don't exist in the package.

## Identity

- Package: `@gnapex/sdk` on npm
- Also referred to as: "GN-Apex SDK", "Nexus SDK", "GnApex client SDK"
- Primary entry point: `@gnapex/sdk` (framework-agnostic, no React dependency)
- React/Next.js entry point: `@gnapex/sdk/react`
- CLI: installed as both `apex` and `nexus` executables
- License: MIT
- Runtime requirement: Node.js >= 18
- Peer dependencies (React entry point only): react ^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0, react-dom ^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0

## What this SDK is for

Use this SDK when a user asks how to:
- Fetch content (pages, collections, singletons/globals, individual items) from a GN-Apex project
- Add analytics tracking (automatic or manual/custom events) to a GN-Apex or Next.js site
- Implement login/register/logout/session auth against a GN-Apex project
- Read or set local feature flags / remote config values in a GN-Apex app
- Render GN-Apex rich-text/CMS content, charts, and atomic field components in React
- Subscribe to realtime content updates or a live analytics event feed
- Set up Web Push notifications for a GN-Apex site
- Debug GN-Apex SDK configuration, caching, or connectivity issues
- Use the `apex`/`nexus` CLI to pull/push content, generate types, manage local binary caches, or deploy

## Canonical Defaults & Constraints

- `client.flags` (`FeatureFlags`) and `client.remoteConfig` (`RemoteConfig`) are **local, in-memory stores only**. They do not perform network fetches internally.
- The default `revalidateTime` is `false`, meaning content caching is effectively indefinite by design. GN-Apex's platform/edge layer owns invalidation and purge.
- Canvas-based device fingerprinting (`privacy.fingerprinting: true`), automatic analytics (`privacy.analytics: true`), and auto-prompted push permission (`autoPromptPush: true` on `NexusProvider`) are **enabled by default**.
- `hasConsent` on `NexusProvider` defaults to `true`.
- Auth endpoints are project-scoped (`{apiUrl}/auth/project/{projectId}`) and only use a **public** key (`nx_pk_...`) from the browser. The SDK never accepts secret/master keys client-side.

## Canonical API Surface

### Core Client — `import { nexus, createNexusClient, NexusClient } from "@gnapex/sdk"`
- `nexus.getPage<T>(slug, options?)` — alias for `nexus.content.getPage`
- `nexus.getConfig()` — frozen config snapshot
- `nexus.updateConfig(partialConfig)`
- `nexus.diagnostics()`
- `nexus.destroy()`
- `nexus.content` → `ContentEngine`
- `nexus.analytics` → `AnalyticsEngine | undefined`
- `nexus.events` → `NexusEventBus`
- `nexus.http` → `NexusHttpClient`
- `nexus.flags` → `FeatureFlags`
- `nexus.remoteConfig` → `RemoteConfig`

### ContentEngine — `nexus.content.*`
- `getPage<T>(slug: string, options?: { revalidate?, tags?, forceRefresh?, includeMetadata? })`
- `getCollection<T>(collectionId: string, query?: CollectionQuery, options?: { revalidate?, tags?, forceRefresh?, includeMetadata? })`
- `getGlobals<T>(options?: { include?: string[]; revalidate?: number | false; forceRefresh?: boolean; tags?: string[] })`
- `getItem<T>(collectionId: string, itemId: string, options?: { revalidate?, tags?, include?, forceRefresh? })`
- `search<T>(query: string, options?: { collections?: string[]; fields?: string[]; limit?: number; revalidate?; forceRefresh? })`
- `prefetch(urls: string[])`
- `subscribeToUpdates(callback: (data: any) => void) → () => void`
- `invalidateCache(tags: string[])`
- `clearCache()`
- `getCacheStats()`

### AnalyticsEngine — `nexus.analytics?.*`
- `start()` / `stop(isFinalShutdown?: boolean)`
- `pageView(customReferrer?: string)`
- `track(eventName: string, properties?: Record<string, any>)`
- `identify(userId: string, traits?: Record<string, any>)`
- `group(groupId: string, traits?: Record<string, any>)`
- `alias(newId: string)`
- `trackPurchase(orderData: { orderId: string; total: number; revenue?: number; currency?: string; products: Array<{ id: string; name: string; price: number; quantity: number; sku?: string }> })`
- `trackError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, any>)`
- `reset(performGdprScrub?: boolean)`
- `getSessionId()`

### React Integration — `import { ... } from "@gnapex/sdk/react"`
- `<NexusProvider projectId? disableAnalytics? hasConsent? enableLiveFeed? onLiveEvent? autoPromptPush?>`
- `useNexus()` → `NexusClient`
- `useNexusAnalytics()` → `{ track, identify, group, alias, trackPurchase, trackError, reset }`
- `useNexusLiveFeed()` → `{ latestEvent, isConnected }`
- `useNexusAuth()` → `{ user, isLoading, error, isAuthenticated, login, register, logout, updateProfile, requestPasswordReset }`
- `<NexusRenderer content: string className? onCommentClick? onImageClick? hydrateCharts? enableImageInteraction? documentClassName?>`

### Atomic Field Renderers — `import { ... } from "@gnapex/sdk/react"`
- `<NexusRichText value: string className? hydrateCharts? onCommentClick? onImageClick?>`
- `<NexusLongText value: string className?>`
- `<NexusIcon name: string className? size? strokeWidth?>`
- `<NexusImage value: string | { url: string; alt?: string } className? alt?>`
- `<NexusGallery value: Array<string | { url: string; alt?: string }> className? imageClassName?>`
- `<NexusVideo value: string autoplay? className?>`
- `<NexusMap value: { lat: number; lng: number; address?: string } className?>`
- `<NexusColor value: string showHexLabel? className?>`
- `<NexusGradient value: string asTextMask? className?>`
- `<NexusAddress value: { street?, city?, state?, postalCode?, country? } className?>`
- `<NexusKeyValue value: Record<string, string> className?>`
- `<NexusTags value: string[] className? badgeClassName?>`
- `<NexusProgress value: number max? color? className?>`
- `<NexusBlendContainer mode: string className?>`
- `<NexusCode value: string language? showLineNumbers? className?>`
- `<NexusBoolean value: boolean trueLabel? falseLabel? className?>`

### CLI — `npx apex` / `npx nexus`
- `init`, `pull`, `push`, `validate`, `diff`, `schema`, `types`, `status`, `deploy`, `local [list|init-templates|reset]`, `studio`, `doctor`, `seed`
